_note: REAL Google reviews for Stationery Point, with real reviewer names and avatars. Confirmed data — do NOT edit, paraphrase, shorten or invent entries. Extracted verbatim from the previous Testimonials.jsx on 17 Aug 2026.

items.name: Vivek D
items.text: This place is hidden treasure in city. One shop for all the stationary and craft items. Their customer service and aquaintance is appreciable. They gave much discount to the things I brought… I saw greeting card here which is not common in shops now a days.

items.name: Gowree Sankar
items.text: Such a lovely little shop! Stationary Point has a great selection of cute cards, books, pens and a variety of craft materials. The shop is well organized, and everything feels thoughtfully picked. Sam, the owner, is super friendly and helpful — always happy to recommend something if you’re unsure. Definitely a go to spot for anyone who loves stationery in kochi!

items.name: Athul Ts
items.text: Whether it’s notebooks, pens, art supplies, or office materials, they have everything we need. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and always ready to help. Prices are reasonable, and the store is well-organized and clean.

items.name: Adhinath umesh Kumar
items.text: Great shop! they have a lot of art supplies and other stationery items. Products are priced below MRP and had a great experience overall. Availability of parking is a plus.

items.name: Toshin U.T
items.text: I regularly purchase office stationary items for my office from Stationery Point. There is a wide range of masking tapes, cello tapes and brown tapes of various sizes here. A4 papers of various brands are sold at very good price.

items.name: Feba Biju
items.text: The store is a hidden gem. It had all the journaling supplies I was looking for. I found plenty of planners, diaries, washi tapes, etc., that too at prices below MRP.

items.name: Kripa sreedhar
items.text: Perfect place to buy stationary items. As an architect student i need lots of stationary items, they helped to find high quality architecture stationary in an affordable price range.

items.name: Abila Abraham
items.text: My kids love Stationery Point! Variety of art items and colouring books, stickers, board games, charts and maps available. I also bought some glass paints and liners for me. All products sold below MRP.

items.name: Kumar Aryan
items.text: Very good stationary place, everything is available and even if something is not then they get it in 1-2 days for you.

items.name: Bijuna K Vinod
items.text: I come here almost every week for all my emergency supplies and they have it all. Affordable prices and at a very convenient location too.

items.name: Athira Mohandas
items.text: Best place for premium and affordable stationary for students,  craft enthusiasts, drawing artists etc.Both wholesale and retail available . Its hidden store near vytila,best in town.always welcoming with new products more over if you want to make pintresty things cone here and explore

items.name: Silpa Gopakumar
items.text: A wonderful stationery shop with wide variety of pens, craft supplies and other carefully curated related items. The space is clean and well organised creating a calm and pleasant shopping experience. What truly elevated my visit is the extremely amazing owner- attentive, knowledgeable and deeply committed for personalised service. Highly recommended

items.name: ARUNN
items.text: Wonder how i missed this shop even though i have paseed here through lot of times. Good genuine decent shop for all your stationery things. Purchased for a refill of old parker pen along with multi colour file and 2025 diary all with genuine rates. Vasudev customer service is down to earth and friendly. Gave 15% discount too. Will recommend. Parking 🅿️ ✅

items.name: Yazinist
items.text: The store boasts an extensive selection of high-quality products, from elegant notebooks and premium pens to unique greeting cards and stylish organizers. The layout is both inviting and well-organized, making it easy to find exactly what you need. The staff is exceptionally friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to offer personalized recommendations and helpful advice. Whether you're a student, a professional, or just a stationery enthusiast, this shop is a true gem. I highly recommend it for anyone seeking beautiful, functional, and inspiring stationery.

items.name: alexina correya
items.text: Great place for fun stationary . It's my favourite place for office stationary and for art and craft supplies. The store owner is very knowledgeable and helps out with the right products once you make the purpose clear.

items.name: Avneesh G
items.text: Excellent shop with several good quality stationary items which I loved. They have decoration, books, school items, perfumed candels. The owner and staff is very helpful and everything is below mrp. Thank you so much!!

items.name: abi holly
items.text: A shop with all stationary items. Very good collection of Parker Pens and price is below MRP. Diaries and Planners are also available. Good customer service. Ample car parking

items.name: Chitra Nair
items.text: Theres not one thing tht u would not find over here, you name it, and they have it!! There are variety of stationary items tht will tempt you enough to get it anyways..one wud really hv to fight the urge to buy anything nd everything, its all so neatly arranged which is a cherry on top, makes it very easy to locate things and the price of the products are too kept accordingly, very reasonable for sure! Really happy to hv found this place, lucky to hv it near to my place!! All Artists out there, do check this place out, damn sure u wudnt leave the place with a bright smile

items.name: Sreeram
items.text: They have got good load of stuffs there for a stationary store. You need any urgent art/crafts materials you've got it there. The owners were very helpful and had a pleasant experience.
